programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沿著地球各地海岸线探险,观察不同自然世界的交会之处,这些相互碰撞的环境孕育出多样而丰富的生物多样性。观看虎鲸展现精准无误的捕食技巧,紧紧抓住瞬间,目睹海鸥幼鸟勇敢地跳下悬崖般的高台,与海龟孵化幼仔一起爬向安全的沙滩,并观察螃蟹在沙滩上塑造出宛如星系般精致复杂的沙雕世界。

programme.title: 上城水獭 #1
programme.desc: 巡视「海湾」家族郁郁葱葱的领土,在这里女族长安娜向族人提供奢华的盛宴,但也面临著内部的异议。打量她的对手米娅——颇具街头智慧的「城里人」家族领导者,她正在考虑改善生活方式,并向与世隔绝的「红树林」家族打探消息。

programme.title: 极限非洲 #4
programme.desc: 进入南部旱地是一趟非洲南部最远端、最干旱和极端环境的旅程。我们到访了几乎不降雨,既壮观又危险的地方,为了寻找适应力极强的动物,并了解牠们生存的秘密。从最大的哺乳类到最敏捷的昆虫,甚至是世上仅有幽灵般的鱼类,南部旱地拥有非凡的居民,生活在世上其中一处最荒凉的栖息地接受日常挑战,牠们都站在同一阵线。

programme.title: 捍衞太平洋 #3
programme.desc: 海洋哺乳类救援队帮助迷路的海龟回家。一头巨大的海狮被发现被十字弓击中,需要吊车才能将牠带到救援中心。马堤博士帮助一只果蝠应付晚年,还有帮助一只好斗的独眼海豹游向自由。

programme.title: 海滩「龟」来记 #
programme.desc: 当成千上万的海龟日以继夜登上哥斯达黎加的海滩生下数以百万计的蛋,当地人称之为「到达」。本节目满是新发现,加拿大自然学家及摄影师胡戈基奇跟随一队国际科学家团队进行创新性的科学考察,以解开这个稀有现象的谜底。

programme.title: 「拟人」动物 #6
programme.desc: 探望忙于帮助鲨鱼保持牙齿闪烁的海上牙医,倾听海豚家族的独特叫声。发掘卷尾猴的开果实工具,并分享长颈鹿相互偎依所带来的温暖,最后与一位流氓狐獴相遇。

programme.title: 魔幻水域的秘密 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​潜入海洋最黑暗、最深邃的深处,探索海洋中那些最神秘莫测、鲜为人知的生物。随著座头鲸横越广阔无垠、延绵不绝的开放水域,然后漫步或缓慢下降至海底深处,亲眼见证令人屏息、令人惊叹的生物发光现象与奇异闪耀景象。

programme.title: 魔幻水域的秘密 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沿著地球各地海岸线探险,观察不同自然世界的交会之处,这些相互碰撞的环境孕育出多样而丰富的生物多样性。观看虎鲸展现精准无误的捕食技巧,紧紧抓住瞬间,目睹海鸥幼鸟勇敢地跳下悬崖般的高台,与海龟孵化幼仔一起爬向安全的沙滩,并观察螃蟹在沙滩上塑造出宛如星系般精致复杂的沙雕世界。

programme.title: 动物感官世界 #5
programme.desc: 某些动物拥有人类难以想像的感官,牠们能凭借这些超能力来完全很多奇妙的事。

programme.title: 非洲隐世国度 #1
programme.desc: 这部纪录片观察德拉肯斯堡山脉上野生动物的生态。我们会看到生物如何在顶峰到山下起伏的草原等无情的地貌中生存。

programme.title: 狒狒: 部落的法则 #
programme.desc: 跟随四个不同物种的四个家族-足智多谋的海滩族、好战的沙漠族、纪律严明的河族和爱好和平的山族,找出这些灵长类成为非洲最成功动物之一的原因。

programme.title: 海洋饕餮盛宴 #
programme.desc: 前排观看地球上最大规模的生物量迁移,即每年沿南非东海岸1000英里的沙丁鱼风暴。数十亿条小鱼仓皇躲避著饥饿的捕食者,其中包括隐秘的海豹和潜水炸弹般的塘鹅。

programme.title: 动物超感官 第一季 #1 英普
programme.desc: 视野对生存尤关重要。这是百分之九十五的动物了解世界的方法。眼睛是如此重要,从难以置信地简单到令人费解地复杂,它们已经独立地进化了近百次。

programme.title: 动物超感官 第一季 #2 英普
programme.desc: 看看那些突破物理、化学和工程极限的动物,牠们实现人类梦想中的能力,并找出进化如何赋予牠们如此惊人的能力。有时生存只能依靠超能力。

programme.title: 动物超感官 第一季 #3 英普
programme.desc: 潜入人类感知以外令人眼花缭乱的世界,动物利用牠们的超感官来感测我们看不到的光、听不到的声音,甚至是我们无法察觉的陌生力量。

programme.title: 澳洲野鸟 #3
programme.desc: 澳洲的猛禽是该处最凶猛的捕食者之一。这些高度专业的杀手强大、足智多谋并十分触目。牠们靠著一些令人印象深刻的武器而生存。这是澳洲空中猎人的故事。

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #1
programme.desc: 在墨西哥瓜达卢普岛附近,顶尖鲨鱼生态学家莫利斯奥许尤士先使用遥视。他将摄影机安装在大白鲨的鳍上,拍摄到一个独特的视野,揭示牠如何游泳、狩猎,并且最终袭击猎物。

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #2
programme.desc: 前往巴哈马的偏远地区,解开鲨鱼的秘密。牠们交友吗?牠们在哪里生育?有品种比其他大胆吗?答案可能有助保护这些至高无上掠食者的后代。

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #3
programme.desc: 海中最快的鱼,尖吻鲭鲨通常是恒温的,这使牠具有敏捷思维以及惊人速度的优势。跟随这种纽西兰海岸附近相对未被研究的品种。

programme.title: 鲨鱼小队 #4
programme.desc: 鲨鱼经常被描绘成容易攻击人类的无脑进食机器,但是它们的行为比之前所认为的更加复杂和聪明。找出这些优雅的顶级捕食者如何互动,选择朋友,甚至训导其他同类。

programme.title: 上城水獭 #1
programme.desc: 巡视「海湾」家族郁郁葱葱的领土,在这里女族长安娜向族人提供奢华的盛宴,但也面临著内部的异议。打量她的对手米娅——颇具街头智慧的「城里人」家族领导者,她正在考虑改善生活方式,并向与世隔绝的「红树林」家族打探消息。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #4
programme.desc: 一头名叫美祖木的年轻雄性鬣狗的故事,围绕生命中最具挑战性的旅程- 找一个新家族。作为一名主导雌性的儿子,牠有一个被优待的童年,但当牠的地位在青春期时下降,因牠被母亲放逐了。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #5
programme.desc: 一个野狗家族生活在尚比亚卢安瓜谷的一角。雌性的巢内有幼崽,这是她和伴侣生养的最新一窝。许多年龄较大的幼崽仍然在一起 - 牠们帮助作保姆,并狩猎食物养活家人。

programme.title: 动物格斗士 #1
programme.desc: 见证斗士们如何在非洲大草原的旱季中争夺水源和其他珍贵资源。亲眼目击狮子和大象为争夺地盘的激烈争斗、蚂蚁袭击白蚁丘、以及蜜獾与毒蛇联袂上演的危险探戈。

programme.title: 动物格斗士 #2
programme.desc: 拜访澳洲最狡猾的斗士和他们惊人的武器库。从袋鼠的致命拳击和红背蜘蛛精密设计的陷阱,暸解他们如何运用这些必杀技击退敌人,同时应对气候变化的侵害。

programme.title: 野生动物明星 #1
programme.desc: 每一天在非洲都上演为生存而挣扎的戏码。捕猎者狂欢,而大自然的拾尸者亦在等待牠们的机会。当强者死亡时,一支军队来吞噬别人留下的东西,因为牠们也必须养育宝贵的家庭。

programme.title: 野生动物明星 #2
programme.desc: 牠们的祖先是第一批在干旱地区殖民的脊椎动物,除南极洲以外,牠们居住在每一个大陆,但牠们的世界正在迅速变化。20个物种称这个城市为家,但过去的湿地成了游乐场、高尔夫球场和赛道。这是牠们坚守的土地。世界各地的青蛙数量正在下降,而且时间所剩无几。

programme.title: 野生动物明星 #3
programme.desc: 在大陆上曾经多不胜数的大象,由于在过去的200年里,因象牙和肉类而被滥捕,令数量急剧减少。然而,南非的阿多大象国家公园和坦比大象公园等大象保护区给予了这些温和的巨人们一点希望,牠们在公园内被保护,免受偷猎者滋扰,令数量正在回升。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #4
programme.desc: 一头名叫美祖木的年轻雄性鬣狗的故事,围绕生命中最具挑战性的旅程- 找一个新家族。作为一名主导雌性的儿子,牠有一个被优待的童年,但当牠的地位在青春期时下降,因牠被母亲放逐了。

programme.desc: 一个野狗家族生活在尚比亚卢安瓜谷的一角。雌性的巢内有幼崽,这是她和伴侣生养的最新一窝。许多年龄较大的幼崽仍然在一起 - 牠们帮助作保姆,并狩猎食物养活家人。

programme.title: 动物感官世界 #6
programme.desc: 人类拥有敏锐的感官,亦是我们能探索环境的关键。不同感官向我们提供生存所需的重要讯息。然而,部份物种也能掌握这些感官,并透过演化转化成生物工程的奇迹。

programme.title: 非洲隐世国度 #2
programme.desc: 南非云山上的古老动植物一直引来人们无限遐想。那里由天气主宰并受入侵者威胁,但这些山脉不仅是现代生态的避难所,也能让我们一窥过去旳面貌。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #6
programme.desc: 从修剪整齐的稻田到野性热带雨林,湄公河是泰国东部的生命之源。一起走访河岸,看看长臂猿如何处理家庭纠纷,并暸解腹蛇如何为该区脆弱的生命网络带来威胁。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #7
programme.desc: 柬埔寨被系于湄公河的水域网络之中,因此与这条大河的关系密不可分。看看这个国家如何展现生物多样性,并见证动物族群如何在未受破坏的自然栖息地中找到秘密庇护所。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #8
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​湄公河是柬埔寨的生命线,尤其是在酷热难耐的旱季,宝贵的水分几乎难以寻觅。深入探索并了解各式各样能展翅飞翔的生物,无论是鸟类还是蝙蝠,牠们在缺水的漫长日子里,善加运用并精打细算管理仅有的资源,直到雨季降临、甘甜的雨水带来久违的慰藉与舒缓。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #9
programme.desc: 湄公河之旅的最后一个国家是湄公河三角洲的发源地。大量营养丰富的物质从数百里外的河流顺流而下,使此地成为越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物宝库。

programme.title: 野性湄公河 #10
programme.desc: 湄公河三角洲是地球上最大的三角洲之一。迄今已有8000年之久,其呈扇形延伸,通过九条水道绵延流入南海。这些水道分割并塑造了海岸线,为各种动物创造了独特的栖息地。

programme.title: 澳洲野鸟 #4
programme.desc: 成功的繁殖对任何鸟类的生存来说都重要尤关,我们在本集会介绍四种鸟类,牠们竭力寻找配偶并抚养后代,为下一代提供最佳的生活机会。无论牠们生活在那里,都有著一堆苦差,保护自己的领地免受入侵者侵害,吸引并赢得配偶,又要保护牠们的雏鸟。

programme.title: 野生动物急诊室 #6
programme.desc: 与大量被遗弃的考拉幼崽打交道,随后与兽医护士尼克 (Nick) 一起寻找治疗小袋鼠肠道疾病的天然药物。思考如何解救被困在树上的蝙蝠宝宝,并观看兽医卡琳娜为一只翅膀骨折的仓鸮进行手术。

programme.title: 极限非洲 #1
programme.desc: 南非的龙山是其中一处拥有大陆上最壮丽美景的地方。它的气候和生态梯度急剧变化,亦影响著陆空生物和天上猛禽的生活环境。

programme.title: 极限非洲 #2
programme.desc: 在坦桑尼亚北部,高耸的山脉形成一个巨大的山谷。它被古老的火山所滋养,坡道为生命提供了多元化的栖息地,而它巨大的重心地带即使在最干燥的时期也能保存水源。

programme.title: 极限非洲 #3
programme.desc: 埃塞俄比亚的塞米恩国家公园住著地球上一些最稀有的生物。窥探非洲最高峰的生活,那是在草原游走毛茸茸的狮尾狒、神出鬼没的塞米恩狼和有角的瓦利亚野山羊的最后堡垒。

programme.title: 极限非洲 #4
programme.desc: 进入南部旱地是一趟非洲南部最远端、最干旱和极端环境的旅程。我们到访了几乎不降雨,既壮观又危险的地方,为了寻找适应力极强的动物,并了解牠们生存的秘密。从最大的哺乳类到最敏捷的昆虫,甚至是世上仅有幽灵般的鱼类,南部旱地拥有非凡的居民,生活在世上其中一处最荒凉的栖息地接受日常挑战,牠们都站在同一阵线。

programme.title: 动物解码 #2
programme.desc: 从超远距离的鲸歌,到大象的亚声,再至墨鱼皮肤上闪烁的讯息,动物们有著令人难以置信的调情、战斗、聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套动物语言等待我们解码。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #1
programme.desc: 与非洲森林象一同穿越纳米比亚沙漠,窥探牠们如何在缺乏食物与遮蔽的环境中保持凉爽。了解这头巨兽如何挑选特定植物充饥、挖掘水井,并翻越无尽的沙丘寻找珍贵水源。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #2
programme.desc: 走访婆罗洲的红树林,与湾鳄一同航行,并见证牠们在盘根错节的水生植物之间穿梭自如。了解牠们如何利用环境调节体温,以及如何凭借惊人的耐性一跃成为顶尖猎手。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #3
programme.desc: 红毛猩猩是丛林中的建筑大师。跟随麦克斯来到婆罗洲的雨林,一起探索这种独居灵长类动物的筑巢艺术。然后见证麦克斯如何尝试逃离满布昆虫的地面,并从红毛猩猩身上学习自然界工程技巧。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #4
programme.desc: 跟随麦克斯来到卢安达的森林追踪黑猩猩,他试图说服这些强壮的猴子相信他是朋友而非敌人。一起学习在丛林觅食的关键技巧,并见证黑猩猩复杂的家庭动态,包括梳理毛发和社交活动。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #5
programme.desc: 跟随麦可斯探索斯里兰卡,窥探懒熊常被误解的神秘世界。见证这种看似人畜无害、毛发蓬乱的动物,如何无畏地击退豹子,并观察牠们如何努力获取所需的营养。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #6
programme.desc: 本集带观众与豹同行,跟随这些自然界的伪装大师,隐没于斯里兰卡的丛林之中。深入了解这种强大的猫科猎手,如何完美适应岛上炎热干燥的气候,并学习牠们的追踪和猎食技巧。

programme.title: 动物解码 #2
programme.desc: 从超远距离的鲸歌,到大象的亚声,再至墨鱼皮肤上闪烁的讯息,动物们有著令人难以置信的调情、战斗、聊天和交合的方式,有著一整套动物语言等待我们解码。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #1
programme.desc: 与非洲森林象一同穿越纳米比亚沙漠,窥探牠们如何在缺乏食物与遮蔽的环境中保持凉爽。了解这头巨兽如何挑选特定植物充饥、挖掘水井,并翻越无尽的沙丘寻找珍贵水源。

programme.desc: 在引人入胜的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的梦想。茱迪心爱的麂羚是时候回归大自然。例行的东非条纹羚捕捉行动发生意想不到的转折。

programme.title: 野生动物守卫员 #6
programme.desc: 在本集一个疣猪回收行动出了差错。来认识韦札保育区的母系社会,一头奇特大象的独家故事。是时候告别韦札的家人。

programme.desc: 随著日照越短、天气越寒冷,加拿大的野生动物正与时间竞赛,任何无法好好利用秋天作准备的动物都将灭亡。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #2
programme.desc: 加拿大的冬天既残酷又美丽;动物们在冰天雪地里挣扎求存;不过,虽然有些动物会静候蓄力,另一些需要抚养孩子的动物则需要迅速适应环境。

programme.title: 艾伦康明最奢华的火车之旅: 苏格兰 #2

programme.title: 巨型运输: 特别篇 #2
programme.desc: 这块巨大的磁石将彻底改变世界和产能的未来。法国南部正建造目前世上最大的核融合反应堆。

programme.title: 生存边缘 #1
programme.desc: 《生存边缘》检视全球生物圈所面临的存亡威胁,以及对地球和奥特亚罗瓦(纽西兰)的未来代表著甚么。

programme.title: 生存边缘 #2
programme.desc: 《生存边缘》探索人类有史以来面临的最大存亡风险之一的未来- 一个生化威胁。从病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威胁的风险。

programme.title: 博物馆的秘密 3 #3
programme.desc: VA 的策展人挖掘物品背后的未知故事,包括非洲时尚、一块肯特布料、一张詹姆斯・巴纳摄影作品,以及一只令人困惑的「古波斯」餐盘。

programme.title: 博物馆的秘密 3 #4
programme.desc: 本周《博物馆的秘密》聚焦产业与设计。策展人马丁准备展出莫里斯・布鲁姆菲尔德的摄影展,珍妮收到稀有的 Biba 生产档案,另展出一条佳姆丹尼纱巾与乔赛亚・韦奇伍德的陶瓷试作品。

programme.title: 博物馆的秘密 3 #5
programme.desc: 本周,修复师 Adriana 清洁一座唐纳泰罗雕像,西蒙收到海伦・米伦在《女王登场》中穿过的戏服,克里斯多福会见设计师肯尼斯・格兰奇爵士,而 VA 邓迪馆邀请艺术家 Yinka Ilori 设计一座色彩缤纷的迷宫。

programme.title: 广告界奇才 #1
programme.desc: 且看50年代的广告活动如何推出新的美国传统和明天会更好的承诺。

programme.title: 广告界奇才 #2
programme.desc: 审视60年代的广告男女,以及他们如何用智慧和嘲讽来接触新受众,因而改革整个产业。

programme.title: 广告界奇才 #3
programme.desc: 且看更严格的规则和公众的不信任如何启发70年代的广告商创造一些史上最伟大的广告活动。

programme.title: 拉斐尔纳达尔: 红土球王
programme.desc: 这部纪录片深入探讨网球传奇拉斐尔纳达尔的人生,探索他从神童成长为全球巨星的历程。透过众多胜利和挑战揭示拿度在球场内外所贡献的遗产。(V374)

programme.title: 克林伊斯威特: 自得其乐

programme.title: 马修派瑞: 不只是朋友
programme.desc: 马修派瑞因饰演昌德宾一角而深受观众喜爱,作为一位值得珍惜的老友和人,人们通过强调他在片场内外的喜剧遗产和个人奋斗的珍藏片段缅怀他。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #5

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #6

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #7

programme.title: 美味走透透: 新加坡 #8

programme.title: 自然保护区 #4

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South AmericaThey have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防风少年— #13
programme.desc: 和以梅宫为首的四天王及干部们见完面,樱等五人在回家路中遇见了可疑的三人组。他们的白色外套上绣著蓝色龙骨,正是那恶名昭彰的集团「KEEL」的特征。樱等人对于他们搜索风铃学生的行为正感到困惑时,遇见了受伤的同班同学杏西。樱能否帮他脱离危机呢?

programme.title: 无名记忆 (第2季) #13
programme.desc: 强国法尔萨斯的王储奥斯卡,为了寻找化解自身诅咒的方法而前往魔法强国,铎洱达尔。在城堡地底长眠的缇娜夏苏醒后虽面露喜色,但现在的奥斯卡却一头雾水。法力高强的缇娜夏虽是铎洱达尔的下一任女王,她却决定留在法尔萨斯城,帮奥斯卡解开诅咒。

programme.title: 无名记忆 (第2季) #14
programme.desc: 魔法师雅尔诺为了用人质交换奥斯卡的宝剑——阿卡西亚,操纵强盗团,趁奥斯卡留在城内时抓走缇娜夏,但缇娜夏不肯乖乖就范,与奥斯卡合力讨伐了强盗团。而袭击的背后主使者正是觊觎法尔萨斯的国家,杜尔札。奥斯卡因为担心爆发战争,要缇娜夏返回铎洱达尔。

programme.title: 无名记忆 (第2季) #15
programme.desc: 有人在缇娜夏的杯中下毒,铎洱达尔的王储雷吉斯也遭到某人袭击。正当城内警戒心升高,名叫德莉拉的女性前来晋见,主张她的力量足以承受奥斯卡的诅咒。奥斯卡虽让她留下,缇娜夏却无法隐藏自己的不满。缇娜夏认识的魔族特拉毕斯现身攻击,让她身负致命重伤…

programme.title: 无名记忆 (第2季) #16
programme.desc: 东国亚尔达的王女涅菲莉因宫中内乱而暂时住在法尔萨斯。正当缇娜夏和涅菲莉都因为喜欢奥斯卡而意识到了彼此,冲著涅菲莉前来的刺客却突破了城堡的结界,显示出内奸的存在。当各国打著自己的如意算盘,亚尔达的侍女却遭到毒杀,可疑的武官也不知去向。

programme.title: 海贼王 #7
programme.desc: 为了营救艾斯,白胡子海贼团与海军本部、七武海在马林福特爆发激战,而鲁夫也率领越狱犯加入战场。鲁夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯却为了保护他而被赤犬击杀,白胡子亦战死。战争最终在红发杰克的介入下落幕。经此一战,鲁夫与伙伴们决定分别修行两年后再会。

programme.desc: 有人在缇娜夏的杯中下毒,铎洱达尔的王储雷吉斯也遭到某人袭击。正当城内警戒心升高,名叫德莉拉的女性前来晋见,主张她的力量足以承受奥斯卡的诅咒。奥斯卡虽让她留下,缇娜夏却无法隐藏自己的不满。缇娜夏认识的魔族特拉毕斯现身攻击,让她身负致命重伤…

programme.title: 无名记忆 (第2季) #16
programme.desc: 东国亚尔达的王女涅菲莉因宫中内乱而暂时住在法尔萨斯。正当缇娜夏和涅菲莉都因为喜欢奥斯卡而意识到了彼此,冲著涅菲莉前来的刺客却突破了城堡的结界,显示出内奸的存在。当各国打著自己的如意算盘,亚尔达的侍女却遭到毒杀,可疑的武官也不知去向。

programme.title: 擅长捉弄人的高木同学3 #1
programme.desc: 西片拿著握力器试图锻炼握力,高木同学却吐槽说他没加入运动社团何必锻炼,紧接著又使出各种手段捉弄他,西片能不屈服于高木同学,持续锻炼握力吗…?收录「晒黑」、「新学期」等三个章节。

programme.title: 擅长捉弄人的高木同学3 #2
programme.desc: 上学途中,西片明明感觉到高木同学的气息却不见她的踪影…而高木同学则是尾随西片不被他发现…这场战斗究竟是谁会获胜呢!?收录「续・气息」、「检查书包」、「图书股长」、「夕阳」等五个章节。

programme.title: 擅长捉弄人的高木同学3 #3

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #1
programme.desc: 为了抗衡来自天界的攻势,恶魔「阿久津雅虎」前来人间寻找具备领袖特质、能拯救魔界的人才。他隐藏自己的真实身份,转学至某所高中就读并遇到了可爱的美少女「天音莉莉」。阿久津认为她可能就是能拯救魔界的「人类」,于是便向她提出邀约,然而……

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #2
programme.desc: 阿久津被莉莉制服并成为了她的仆人,被迫协助她狩猎恶魔。阿久津拒绝协助,并表示他宁愿被净化也不愿杀死自己的同类。于是莉莉便启动了套在阿久津颈上的「夺走自由并施以惩罚的颈圈的力量」。然后,阿久津的身体就不由自主地开始动了起来……

programme.title: 海贼王 #7
programme.desc: 为了营救艾斯,白胡子海贼团与海军本部、七武海在马林福特爆发激战,而鲁夫也率领越狱犯加入战场。鲁夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯却为了保护他而被赤犬击杀,白胡子亦战死。战争最终在红发杰克的介入下落幕。经此一战,鲁夫与伙伴们决定分别修行两年后再会。

programme.desc: 每天早晨透过诗歌安静心灵,从牧者及嘉宾的分享学习《圣经》中的真理,让观众由浅入深认识信仰,默想《圣经》教导。

programme.title: 来!为这城祷告
programme.desc: 你们要为那城求平安,为那城祷告耶和华;因为那城得平安,你们也随著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 圣地流动教室-以色列破谜之旅
programme.desc: 通晓中西方历史、文学、艺术、民间传说的学者吴宗文牧师,以及主持梁艺龄,透过镜头带著电视观众,去到圣地各站游历,呈现出新旧约的《圣经》典故、历史文献的记载、相关的犹太传说和传统习俗,而更重要是从耶稣和初期信徒的记载,带出人生的重要特质,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 「创世电视福音主日」-「不由你不信之从灵界迷惑到真相大白 」
programme.desc: 「超阔银幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大众化的福音主题」,加上「诚意的款待」会产生极致的「福音体验」

programme.desc: 《新闻今日谈》:节目针对当天最热门时事问题,在观众最关注的时刻即时作出评论,让观众更洞悉事件的真相。

programme.title: 筑梦天下 (468)
programme.desc: 《筑梦天下》寻找中外不同风格的建筑、民居,道出背后的环境因素和地理条件,详述生活于其间的人物,细诉人和建筑之间纠缠不清的故事。

programme.title: 风云对话 (407)
programme.desc: 《风云对话》是一个高素质的访谈节目,节目采访全球“最关键、最前线、最敏感权倾一时的掌权者,他们影响并决定著整个国际局势的变化和发展。一个个世界级人物在节目中,亲自向您剖析他们的观点。

programme.title: 近观中国 (212)
programme.desc: 《近观中国》:全新推出的观察类纪录片栏目。每一期以一名外国人为主角,游走中国各地,以近距离的视角观察中国社会状况和中国人的生活。

programme.title: 我的香港故事 (212)
programme.desc: 《我的香港故事》:人物记录专题栏目。通过每集大约15分钟的精致篇幅,讲述香港人的故事与发生的事。为全国华人观众,了解香港新的视觉。

programme.title: 笑逐言开 (616)
programme.desc: 《笑逐言开》是节目运用崭新的多媒体手段和独特的串连解读方式,通过主持人现场脱口秀来演绎各类资讯,带给您更有营养的周末。

高朋满座#38粤
programme.desc: 溢满对新款PDA手提电话心动，可是订价太贵，他吃朱古力时咬到金币，竟中奖得到该款手提电话，溢满将金币藏在糯米中。溢满发现粽内竟没金币，有义说吃粽时得到中奖金币，更将金币送给溢满，溢满终坦承一切。

programme.title: 天龙八部#11粤普PG
programme.desc: 阿朱中了玄慈大师的大金刚掌，虽被乔峰救下，却命在旦夕。乔峰得知薛神医要在聚贤庄举行英雄大会，便冒险带阿朱前去求医，却遭到各路英雄冷嘲热讽。乔峰断然喝下绝交酒，与在场英雄往日旧情一笔勾销…

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 南海狮山镇盛产雷公凿苦瓜，鼎爷和阿谭在当地尝一顿苦瓜宴。回到香港，鼎爷即席鲜榨苦瓜汁，巧制甜品「苦瓜红豆糕」，有何方法令红豆平均分布？再来「苦瓜炒蛋」，鼎爷预先备好芡汁，烹调时先炒苦瓜后加鸡蛋，淋上芡汁，阿谭的儿时美食登场！鼎爷带阿谭到澳门品尝「澳门三宝」中的厣仔蟹、乌鱼佳肴；返港更找来余下一宝的矜贵野生方利，炮制「古法荷叶蒸方利」，下镬前却要留意清洁鱼身的方法。方利味淡，鼎爷用上甚么配料来取味？

programme.title: 汇丰Premier Elite 呈献：汇丰Premier Elite财富汇谈粤
programme.desc: 金融市场瞬息万变，加上科技发展日新月异，如何影响投资市场？《汇丰Premier Elite财富汇谈》，云集不同行业专家，剖析市场趋势，讲解金融、投资及理财等话题，务求做到深入浅出，聚焦分析不同议题，为大家捕捉市场先机。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 农历新年其间，长者的饮食与作息容易被打乱，特别是三高患者更要注意。老人科医生提醒，贺年糖果、糕点容易令血糖升高，建议长者多摄取蛋白质食物。有高血压问题的老友记，医生提醒过新年亦宜保持清淡饮食、定时服药，并维持规律作息。新春妆容讲求精神奕奕，如出现黑眼圈、眼睛浮肿等问题，怎样处理？专业化妆师示范相关化妆技巧，助大家营造逆龄效果，以最佳状态迎接马年。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，Annie师傅示范「炖羊肚菌汤」。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在广州粤
programme.desc: 广州，粤菜发源地之一，广府菜的中心，是每一位食客都无法拒绝的美食圣地。爱吃爱玩的主持人麦包，在广州彻底释放了吃货天性，走遍大街小巷，寻找地道美食：悠闲早茶、西关小吃、新潮佳馔，夜市小摊

programme.title: 单恋双城#11粤
programme.desc: 展禛逼钱进教她做甜品。洪叔洪婶的访问受欢迎，尼斯被形容为浪漫酒店，刘音得到启发，邀式适协助做计划书。式适以挂念父亲为由辞职，钱进得知后也想辞职。书舒透露专荣收了警告信，需把居屋单位出租作开源节流。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 情人节来临，适逢社区举行义卖会，宏志代人穿上兔子戏服，危急中扶了妈妈一把，其他人却没发现。天气寒冷，嫲嫲教小丸子肚皮用力的御寒方法，后来小丸子自行创出想像自己身处夏天的怪招。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 农历新年临近，在家居摆放年桔寓意大吉大利。本集「Artspiration」中，子健哥哥将教大家绘画年桔，大家可跟随指引完成作品，再把画作张贴在家中，不仅增添过年氛，也可感受创作乐趣。一于赶快准备好纸和笔，并细心留意子健哥哥的示范技巧。这次「开心SHARE」的主题，是「我最喜欢的动物」，小朋友投稿分享绘画了熊猫、北极狐、海豚等动物的图画，洋溢童真。这些作品亦唤起主持姐姐们对相关动物的回忆与兴趣。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: 维多利亚有感可爱力量不足，继而向珠希求助。珠希见状，便举办一个名为「Victoria可爱精选」的活动，向全校师生招募他们心目中的可爱事物。可是，有群相信肌肉就是可爱的学生接连投稿，竟令Aiprigram充斥著热波老师的……

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 利嘉阁地产45 周年真盘源特约：今日有楼睇粤 及 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
programme.desc: 由独立屋搬入分层单位，往往需要适应，设计师如何在间隔方面，保留空间感？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 世界观粤 及 天气报告粤
东张西望粤
programme.desc: 再有港人北上美发疑受骗，事主于深圳连锁发型屋充值，怎料约一年后再光顾，却被告知因系统转换、店舖易手等原因无法扣款。事主质疑店方销售手法，提醒港人预缴式消费时要提高警觉。婆婆带宠物鹦鹉外出散步遇事故，鹦鹉受惊飞走。有救援组织寻获疑似走失的鹦鹉，婆婆遂联络组织负责人郭秀云提出认领。然而交接时，婆婆认为该鹦鹉并非自己的爱鸟，并指控郭秀云私藏鹦鹉。其后，郭秀云更收到恐吓字条……另介绍中环海滨的贺岁好去处。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2745粤
programme.desc: 速熊对面的单位，开设了新的物流公司，成功以宣传技俩抢去速熊不少生意。速熊的招牌不及对手，树根打算更换招牌，却舍不得斥巨资找人题字。树仁提出一个解决方法，并与熊家众人出埠前赴某群岛。因某些理由，熊姓人士在岛上可获得贵宾待遇，若水等在岛上享有特别福利，树根更可分文不费，便能订造速熊的招牌。后来，因发生变故，熊姓人士的福利遭取消，树根等人为免被追讨费用，必须尽快逃离该群岛……

programme.title: 非常检控观#20粤PG
programme.desc: 熊飞与逸桐和好，逸桐主动表白。善昱出任庆历慈善基金会主席，希仁镜反射到被收养的泰国孤儿情绪不安，感疑惑。晶晶在泰国失踪，湘言收到其求救讯息，熊飞查出源自庆历资助的儿童院舍，与湘言查看后并无发现，却引起逸桐嫉妒，熊飞决定跟逸桐说清楚。希仁等暗中查探，怀疑基金会或涉人口贩卖。湘言请求善昱帮忙；众人得悉儿童院舍人员陶诚伟，或跟泰巨有联繋。湘言设法调查诚伟，得知晶晶似被运至酒店某个房间，遂前往寻找……

programme.title: 欢乐茶饭#12粤普PG
programme.desc: 林晏听到沈家人被赵王带走，向赵王坚持一定要见到他们，赵王手下带林晏赶到牢房时，发现沈家人已经逃走。沈家人稍作休息时，官兵追至，凤霞让韶光带央央先跑，一名官兵紧追不舍，韶光便把央央藏起来，自己引开追兵…

programme.title: 香港欧化飞鹰活络油呈献：一马当先行大运粤
programme.desc: 李丞责与《非常检控观》演员马德钟、赖慰玲、吴伟豪、游嘉欣同吃团年饭，师傅根据九运，提议团队拍摄超越时空的续集！马年是带旺马德钟的年份吗？伟豪想改艺名？测一测字就有指引。文昌位有助学生考取佳绩，玲玲师傅提议文具颜色及挥春摆位，以提升学业，也求驱病减煞。主持展望、蒨文向碧霞师傅请教，如何因应睡床方位布置或更换特定颜色床单，催旺财运？另外，璞初师傅教大家赤脚行「接地气」增运；法铭师傅则带来家居开运大法。

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 天气报告粤 及 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
廉政行动2024#5粤PG
programme.desc: 廉署接获匿名信得悉一宗保险有关的行贿案件，投诉人指一班经纪有组织地以不当手法赚取公司佣金，而主脑是乐琦。调查发现乐琦与其中一名女客人黄凤瑛交往甚密，其丈夫潘德成早前行山意外堕山身亡，意外前不久才买下一笔巨额人寿，受益人正是凤瑛，经深入调查后，廉署决定找乐琦和凤瑛回廉署接受调查。问话期间，乐琦坚持是凤瑛主动给他30%赔偿金作为加速申请赔偿的报酬，而另一边厢凤瑛却说是对方向她索取30%的赔偿金。正当案件胶著之际，廉署竟然发现德成在香港出现的行踪……

programme.desc: 溢满对新款PDA手提电话心动，可是订价太贵，他吃朱古力时咬到金币，竟中奖得到该款手提电话，溢满将金币藏在糯米中。溢满发现粽内竟没金币，有义说吃粽时得到中奖金币，更将金币送给溢满，溢满终坦承一切。

programme.title: 天龙八部#11粤普PG
programme.desc: 阿朱中了玄慈大师的大金刚掌，虽被乔峰救下，却命在旦夕。乔峰得知薛神医要在聚贤庄举行英雄大会，便冒险带阿朱前去求医，却遭到各路英雄冷嘲热讽。乔峰断然喝下绝交酒，与在场英雄往日旧情一笔勾销…

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 麦美恩、黄耀英、吴幸美挑战街市档贩对菜、鱼、鸡相关歇后语的认识。掌故专家郑宝鸿讲解「新泽西」与「石罅米」的出处；大学讲师廖舜禧解读何谓「冇尾烧猪」。耀英、美恩搞笑合演「醉酒佬数街灯」，句末有何妙趣？

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 大学讲师廖舜禧在文武庙讲解「波罗鸡」及「呃鬼食豆腐」相关典故。屏山邓氏宗祠、觐廷书室古迹游，邓达智介绍分猪肉、谢灶习俗。郑宝鸿带来「亚聋送殡」、「撒路溪钱」的出处。主持还鬼马演绎「盲公食云吞」。

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
香港早晨粤 及 亚太眼科学会特约:香港眼科 · 全球视野粤
隆行天下之重走八千里路云和月普
手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 文房四宝中的墨, 制作步骤比起其他三宝都要复杂 本集会介绍用松树等大自然材料, 经过火烧、搓揉等多重步骤制造出的松烟墨, 不只保留松树独有的气节和松香, 更是书生们书房里的珍贵宝物

programme.title: 世界独特社区粤普
programme.desc: 荷兰是个重视长者照护与福利的国家，推出多种养老模式，帮老人保持身体健康, 拥有积极的生活态度，良好的自理能力。清迈以国外老人为主的高级疗养园，老人在这里有个人空间、还有专业看护照顾，过著渡假般的生活。

programme.title: 仨心友行粤
programme.desc: 三位美女带诺懿走进菜园，亲手采摘新鲜食材。高Ling雀跃地摘取树上的椰子，却又惧怕虫子，画面趣怪！甫看到园内的秋千玩意，一行人顿变大细路，展现童真一面。满载而归后，众人边尝有机火锅边细诉理想退休环境，诺懿、敏之、嘉欣皆希望开设自家农庄，享受朴素生活。来到劳勿的度假村，诺懿、高Ling勇闯热带雨林冒险，还扬言要挑战跳瀑布……探险之后，二人获敏之、嘉欣以美点慰劳，并畅谈跳瀑布威水史，为何却不禁偷笑？

programme.title: 玩转香港日与夜粤
programme.desc: 荃湾、葵青遍布街坊熟悉、但外来人未必认识的消闲好去处。「游生」袁文杰、林韦辰、丁子朗三位型男于周末结伴同行，齐齐发掘两区吃喝玩乐热点。「期间限定」楼梯画突破视觉空间；试玩巨型象棋、麻雀，乐趣满分！清早到访荃湾川龙品尝山水靓茶，叹尽写意人生。43条天桥连贯大小商场，交织出「离地」购物之乐。深井甜品远近驰名，路德围食店越夜越美味！远眺壮丽青马大桥之外，三人还会走进涌美老屋村，寻找传统客家风味！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 从心理学角度切入，快乐是一种感到幸福、满足、愉快的心理状态，其来源可能包括健康、安全、爱与成就感等，谷主凯婷更找来一条「快乐方程式」，如何计算？据指在心理学上有三大不快乐因素，会是甚么？有机构评选出，芬兰连续八年蝉联全球最幸福国家或地区的榜首，众谷主谈论当地民众的快乐泉源，笑言跟他们在职时可享四星期暑假有莫大关系。凯婷又与泳嘉、凯文讨论如何获取快乐，提出要做到知行合一、避免与别人过份比较等方法。

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 煮东煮西粤
programme.desc: 淀粉食物识得煮，也可发挥均衡饮食之道。燕麦米含有丰富膳食纤维，混合白米，健康升华！保哥用虾干、银鱼干炮制中式荷叶饭，家嘉则以鸭腿、鹅油奉上法式煲仔饭，同样是中秋聚餐之选。过节必备「笑虾虾」，保哥以茄汁大虾配煎米粉，还提示诗雅将生虾浸冰水会较易去壳；米粉要煎得干身脆口，又有甚么秘诀？家嘉将ABC粉、牛肉搓成肉丸再炸，卖相味道兼备，为食翠如吃不停！最后以喾仪巧制的「抺茶忌廉芝士奶冻」作结，才算圆满！

programme.title: 诸朋恋友粤
programme.desc: 陈展鹏、黎诺懿、徐荣、陆浩明带同另一半放闪，六号还携来女友每年的惊喜小手作。徐荣夫妇难忘在产房度过情人节；诺懿竟为放弃照顾伴侣，而于对方生日派对灌醉自己？展鹏不时在纪律部队题材剧集展示体能，现实中也曾为单文柔来回跑廿几层楼梯？情人节非恋人专利，方力申、连诗雅、郭子豪、江嘉敏、孔德贤、游嘉欣也来凑热闹，「围炉分析」单身原因。初次约会应否展现真性情？嘉欣、子豪各有经历。德贤则接受不了女生太快爱上自己？

programme.title: 成人教科书粤
programme.desc: 大部份人对「男、女」有既定概念，主持洪永城要求五位小朋友就着吃甜品、打架、八卦等较切合男或女来投票，结果如何？从名字可否判断一个人是男是女？首集请来六位艺人让小朋友竞猜。乍听「邓英敏」这名字，众人都一致觉得是女性，「黄梓玮」也令大家十分混乱。另外，其中两位女生提及女士太健壮并不合乎漂亮的「标准」，更有人认为跳舞、绘画等较优雅的活动才适合女性。永城引领三位女生挑战忍者式体能锻练，她们试玩后可会改观？

programme.title: 地球大神秘粤
programme.desc: 今年是人类充满惶恐不安的一年，网络上流传不少大灾难的预言：中东战火、日本超级大地震等，我们的明天究竟会怎样呢？很多人想预知未来，研究它的真假，在网络资讯爆炸的时代，越讲越真，越知道反而越惊，就好像圣经一早预言：『人想起将要临到世界的事，就吓得魂不附体』这一刻，站在文明悬崖上的我们，是否正要见证这古老预言成为现实？在全新一辑的地球大神秘，我们会继续从世界各地神秘事件，探讨各种预言的真确，还会同被称为最准确重要的预言书《圣经》作对比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 后空翻少年粤日
programme.desc: 怀著最坏的打算，翔太郎在志田教练批准下带伤上阵，并在比赛后立即到医院验伤。在检查途中，翔太郎一直惦记大赛结果，但是，无论是与他同行的美里，还是其他队员，竟然都对赛果三缄其口……

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 这次「WORKOUT 2GETHER」由欧鸿斌教练指引大家做肌耐力与协调能力运动。抬腿及折腿的动作看似相近，但实际上有何分别？外八字脚连续半蹲，马步要够稳，腰要挺直！然后拿出阻力带，转为两人一组，合拍地完成指定动作，看看谁能支撑较久。接着以小球作辅助工具，投入协调能力训练。在不看球的情况下，能否顺利做到弹地接球？将球分别夹于大腿、小腿与脚踝位置，并原地跳，难度越来越高，在场小朋友都专注完成挑战。

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 猪太郎帮老婆婆过马路，收到巧克力作为回礼，谁知被同学误以为是情人节巧克力，掀起一场风波。学校即将举行马拉松比赛，令小丸子心情郁结，爷爷受到电视节目启发，决定自告奋勇担任其教练。

programme.title: 这十年幸福中国粤
programme.desc: 本片从城市到乡村，以科技、社会、民生、体育、文化等多个角度出发，用小故事展现大主题、用小视角透视大时代，记录各行各业普通人的工作与生活，体现幸福是奋斗出来的思想。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 新闻透视粤 及 亚太眼科学会特约:香港眼科 · 全球视野粤
programme.desc: 本台发现有人怀疑非法开垦政府土地，在山头开路，政府会如何执法？过去5年，当局合共处理接近六万宗霸地个案，只有98宗被检控。有人承认在政府土地，兴建设施及放置私人物品20年，就算经地政署确认涉及非法占用政府用地，违法建构物至今仍然未移除，也无人被检控，为甚么？2015年政府增加首次非法占用政府用地定罪罚款，由罚款1万增至50万，是否有足够阻吓力？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 京东呈献：爱心改造家粤
programme.desc: 三十出头的晴晴，失婚后跟一对儿女暂住母亲家中，直至最近终可「上楼」，决意为子女打造最温馨的家。晴晴提到会在家中工作，只要划出客厅区域设置工作台，就可边用电脑剪片，边看顾两兄妹。宅Sir为将来会再长高的十岁哥哥选择木床，指出床的长度随时可延伸，改造性够高！晴晴选用覆合材料为全屋铺地板，有何优点？不过，厨房及厕所门口却不宜铺地毡？森美、璇璇随同晴晴一家三口参观新居，甫开门，儿子直言仿如走进了示范单位！

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈献:唱钱粤
programme.desc: 音准、拍子大考验，唱歌随时有钱落袋！来自马来西亚的《中年好声音3》亚军唱将张与辰接受《唱钱》洗礼，透过挑战Sing盘上不同歌曲难度「过三关」，甚至是最难的Monster关卡，向扫清九宫格的目标进发。观众只需用手机扫描萤幕上的QR Code，即可参与直播室互动，为挑战者打气，更有机会赢取福利。

programme.title: J Music粤
programme.desc: 关智斌在启德举行个唱后，即将于澳门再开骚，演出上有甚么调整？除了送上两首跳唱歌，他亦藉<My Little Tinker Bell感谢身边众人一直以来的支持。许靖韵赴佛山巡唱前，以<请勿打扰作热身。吴若希分享台上唱错歌词的趣事，这次演绎<超前告别又可会「虾碌」？适逢情人节，主持冼靖峰、李尹嫣「一晚限定」合唱甜蜜冧歌<劲浪漫 超温馨。

programme.title: 美食新闻周报粤
programme.desc: 新春大吉，晖哥偕同鼎爷前往品尝特色淮扬菜，包括文思豆腐松叶蟹、双剁椒凤凰鸽等菜式，刀工精细，各有特别寓意，吉祥如意！星厨莫灿霖带波波造访一间「人气」餐厅，细尝椒麻芥末炝花甲、陈皮榄角田鸡腊肠煲仔饭等佳肴，满是惊喜滋味！萧欣浩博士则与伍倩彤一起养生进补，享用太史五蛇羹、生扣蛇骨腩等美食，并细说食蛇的「尝识」。黄嘉雯驾车带胡美贻上山顶「揾食」，品尝三色杂锦小笼包、宫保虾球等特色上海佳肴，别具风味！

programme.title: J Sport粤
programme.desc: 跆拳道女将江丽莉登上世界排名第三；壁球代表刘子均首夺亚锦赛金牌，二人诉说2025年深刻点滴。网球港队于台维斯杯不敌芬兰队，无缘升上世界一组，黄泽林赛后细谈感受。国际马术盛典音乐骑术表演中，看到退役赛驹身影，个中「转型」道路是怎样的？港队于公路单车亚锦赛收获佳绩，日前凯旋返港。体院开放日吸引市民参观；体操名将石伟雄出席活动，推动大家多做运动。另有滑浪风翼世界杯香港站战报，及全运会港区义工表扬礼花絮。

programme.title: 财经透视粤
programme.desc: 《财经透视》紧贴大市，回顾每周港股走势外，并关注楼市状况，透过业界人士专访、市场分析等，深入浅出探讨本港、国际财经金融热门话题，更以专题形式报道不同行业发展面对的问题。

programme.title: 仨心友行粤
programme.desc: 三位美女带诺懿走进菜园，亲手采摘新鲜食材。高Ling雀跃地摘取树上的椰子，却又惧怕虫子，画面趣怪！甫看到园内的秋千玩意，一行人顿变大细路，展现童真一面。满载而归后，众人边尝有机火锅边细诉理想退休环境，诺懿、敏之、嘉欣皆希望开设自家农庄，享受朴素生活。来到劳勿的度假村，诺懿、高Ling勇闯热带雨林冒险，还扬言要挑战跳瀑布……探险之后，二人获敏之、嘉欣以美点慰劳，并畅谈跳瀑布威水史，为何却不禁偷笑？

programme.title: 成人教科书粤
programme.desc: 大部份人对「男、女」有既定概念，主持洪永城要求五位小朋友就着吃甜品、打架、八卦等较切合男或女来投票，结果如何？从名字可否判断一个人是男是女？首集请来六位艺人让小朋友竞猜。乍听「邓英敏」这名字，众人都一致觉得是女性，「黄梓玮」也令大家十分混乱。另外，其中两位女生提及女士太健壮并不合乎漂亮的「标准」，更有人认为跳舞、绘画等较优雅的活动才适合女性。永城引领三位女生挑战忍者式体能锻练，她们试玩后可会改观？

programme.title: 手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 文房四宝中的墨, 制作步骤比起其他三宝都要复杂 本集会介绍用松树等大自然材料, 经过火烧、搓揉等多重步骤制造出的松烟墨, 不只保留松树独有的气节和松香, 更是书生们书房里的珍贵宝物

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路云和月普
粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 麦美恩、黄耀英、吴幸美挑战街市档贩对菜、鱼、鸡相关歇后语的认识。掌故专家郑宝鸿讲解「新泽西」与「石罅米」的出处；大学讲师廖舜禧解读何谓「冇尾烧猪」。耀英、美恩搞笑合演「醉酒佬数街灯」，句末有何妙趣？

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 大学讲师廖舜禧在文武庙讲解「波罗鸡」及「呃鬼食豆腐」相关典故。屏山邓氏宗祠、觐廷书室古迹游，邓达智介绍分猪肉、谢灶习俗。郑宝鸿带来「亚聋送殡」、「撒路溪钱」的出处。主持还鬼马演绎「盲公食云吞」。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粤
programme.desc: 众艺员先以身体部位的粗幼长短分组，输家全落入特玩队，是否代表胜出机会渺茫？杨潮凯有独特策略，「分拆」肉丸击倒保龄球樽抢分！自称「夜蒲之王」的翟威廉挑战乒乓过三关，却发觉爱蒲高手多的是！黄美棋随便的一抛便能成功入球，进一步削减威廉士气。当众人已不看好他时，他却施展非一般腰力，单脚站着叼起地面上的纸张，令人刮目相看。众人落力踏单车争出线，何浩文化身魔鬼教练督促队员，落场时却玩得脸青唇白，最终会否输掉？

programme.title: 熊猫一家人粤普
programme.desc: 两组实习生的导师李德红和李蓉分别因为休假和参加培训而迎来了代班导师牟长雨和胡荣强，实习生们和两位导师会产生什么样的化学作用呢？另外为了庆祝将满一岁的鑫鑫的宝宝，马余英和金奕霖准备给牠做一个食物丰容…

programme.title: 星梦频道粤日
programme.desc: 随著宝石时装大赛进入倒数阶段，大赛便成为了闪亮宿的热话。据说大赛奖品钻石造型能够实现任何梦想，令到宝石偶像都开始谈起她们的心愿，因而激发了奈瑠的兴趣，想打听大家有著什么梦想，可是……

programme.title: 星梦频道粤日 及 防灾贴士你要知2粤
programme.desc: 最近没看到黛雅做节目，奇迹闪耀组与虹之咲都为此感到担心，希望前往虚拟世界见她一面。玫儿见状，便即场发明传送机器，并由Meltic StAr与虹之咲一起到虚拟世界找出黛雅，但虚拟世界似乎在发生异变……

programme.title: 多啦A梦粤
programme.desc: 大雄被嘲笑不懂砌模型，多啦A梦于是借他「地球套餐」，让他创建小型地球，谁知地球被妈妈扔掉，造成大灾难。大雄等人为了争夺猪肉包，被迫与胖虎玩捉迷藏，多啦A梦借出「魔术拉链」助其一把。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星团粤日
programme.desc: KiLLER KiNG知道他们的新歌被选为电影的主题曲后非常开心，但是翼和他们却被夹在赞助商的意见和自己的希望之间进退两难，就在这个过程中，弥勒在导演启发下领略到一个重要道理，带领成员们走出困局。

programme.title: 魔都女行粤
programme.desc: 糖妹、谷娅溦置身「魔都」上海，来到地标武康大楼跟前，用小嘴巴浅嚼大楼面包另类打卡后，启动「早咖晚酒」生活。大吃手撕猪肉贝果，专家糖妹试后感如何？寻觅隐世小店，必点镇店菜肉馄饨。医肚后逛逛街，主打迷你装束的时尚女装店，血拼解锁！走进玻璃屋餐厅，生牛肉塔塔、开心果碎甜虾等满桌美食卖相精致，糖妹品尝布拉塔芝士，味道「古怪」却吃不停口？入夜，怎可错过上海本邦菜，黑松露红烧肉、松鼠桂鱼，打卡指数又有多高？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 肥妈和6号前往位于元朗的有机农场，搜罗多种「有营」蔬果，为主打健康的新一辑节目打响头炮。番茄含有丰富茄红素，多吃有助保护心脏、预防前列腺疾病。二人试食黑皮车厘茄，竟渗出阵阵烟肉风味！制作「羽衣甘蓝番茄藜麦干果沙律」，务要将蔬菜切碎，当中有何饮食智慧？「南瓜粟米腰果汤」滋补脾胃；另一道「南瓜汤浸比目鱼」做法简单，奥米加3却有护眼强脑功效。「煎焗无激素鸡」选用丹麦自然放养鸡，嫩滑鸡胸更令肥妈情有独钟。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 肥妈今回选用鸭的多个部位煮出四道美馔，果然「点煮都Duck」！「白卤水鸭」香浓味美，与有色卤水汁有何不同？啤梨搭配鸭肝同吃，可中和油腻感。一道「煎鸭肝烩啤梨」讲求火候掌控，6号却以慢活节奏为啤梨切片，阿妈不禁火起！6号再探有机农场，初尝翠玉瓜人工授粉步骤，还替肥妈摘取新鲜的荷兰豆和甜豆。肥妈以含有高蛋白质、铁质的鸭胸，配合「孖豆」爆炒菜式；再带来「翠玉彩椒炒鸭肾」，处理鸭肾、鸭心又有甚么需要注意？

programme.title: 防灾贴士你要知2粤
programme.desc: 灾祸无情，为保障生命及财产安全，广大市民务必时刻保持高度的防灾意识。由冯盈盈、何晋乐等「星级」艺员参演的《防灾贴士你要知 2》，以短剧形式向大家传递防止灾害发生、遇危难时逃命的贴士,，还有消防处代表带来相关知识与实用资讯。

programme.title: 少年中医说粤普
programme.desc: 节目聚焦于青年族群体验中医药文化，集结中国七所中医药的7名高校学子，在主持人和中医药名家的带领下，探寻中华医圣故里，以「盲盒路线分组体验」医圣故里的形式，了解医圣对当代中医药发展的启示。

programme.title: 吃货横扫曼谷粤
programme.desc: 澄光带慧中、星妤品尝潮汕美食「粿汁」，滋味秘密来自一锅胡椒汤底。四位主持齐齐食汉堡，除牛肉外，用素肉、吞拿鱼制成的汉堡扒亦有惊喜。星妤、慧中体验三款特色水疗，何解星妤感觉仿如置身死海？一间店可满足主持们吃泰菜与叹咖啡两大要求，供应的泰国东北部菜肴味道有何特色？澄光、慧中寻访人气「芒果糯米饭」，据称做法源于皇官！夜市聚餐由星妤请客，「火山排骨」体积巨大得惊人，还有材料丰富的海鲜拼盘，众拍档开怀大嚼。

programme.title: 吃货横扫曼谷粤
programme.desc: 曼谷的潮式牛腩面名店，内里竟可打边炉？看见海宁在陶瓷上绘画，原来她置身一间结合手绘陶瓷体验的咖啡店。店内还遇上狗店长，「女神」更主动求吻！三位女神再次享受矜贵SPA，慧中和星妤的眉心被放上石块再滴油，感受如何？澄光推介的猪手美食究竟有多滋味，让星妤不顾仪态一口把猪皮往嘴里塞？海宁发掘一间环境清新的纯素餐厅，并可找到Pizza、担担面等多国食品。慧中、星妤、澄光坐船畅游湄南河，还以夕阳作伴写意打卡。

programme.title: 甜心先生粤
programme.desc: 周奕玮经常走访不同国家，因此有机会见识不同甜品。最近，他趁著到日本旅游机会，品尝了一款充满地道风味的抹茶Tiramisu，并希望亲手试做，再三回味，甜品达人古嘉俊(阿古)因应他的口味，示范「抹茶蓝莓蛋糕」。蛋糕外表色彩缤纷，紫红色蓝莓镜面配上花花装饰后，增添和风。至于口味方面，抹茶蛋糕配以蓝莓白朱古力慕丝，以创新组合为食家送上新鲜感。向甜品达人偷师当然获益良多，周奕玮还寻获无比乐趣。

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日
programme.desc: 大成太晴的姐姐，天才系统工程师大成伊奈失踪两年后，大成转学到伊奈从前就读的进开学园，并认识到铁路部的良太和舞。此时突然传来警报，睽违十年的怪物再度出现，两人奉命把太晴带去超铁机。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 本集「My Little Show」，一位女生提着花篮跳芭蕾舞，舞姿优雅；另一位女生则以长笛吹奏某出动画电影的主题曲，音色柔和动听。两项表演各有特色，令人陶醉其中。不少儿歌以健康生活习惯为主题，让孩子于聆听歌曲时吸收歌词中的知识，建立正向生活态度。波波姐姐与主持姐姐合唱<蔬果超人大战秘秘怪兽、<刷牙歌，节奏轻快有趣。收看节目的小朋友亦可跟着唱，并尽力尝试培养良好习惯。

programme.title: 屁屁侦探粤日
programme.desc: 蛙蛙王国举行纪念舞会，展出国宝「蝌蚪之卵」，讵料放置国宝的房间传出声响，芝娃娃局长更涉嫌偷窃国宝，为证明其清白，汪汪警察局与名犬警察局破天荒首次合作，在屁屁侦探带领下追捕真正犯人。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 俊子透过有奖贺年明信片，得到了一些奖品。见此，小丸子决意核对所有收到的贺年明信片有否中奖。经过一轮核对之后，终于发现有一张是中了奖的。但是，那张中了奖的明信片上，却写著一些令小丸子困惑的字句。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 这十年幸福中国粤
programme.desc: 本片从城市到乡村，以科技、社会、民生、体育、文化等多个角度出发，用小故事展现大主题、用小视角透视大时代，记录各行各业普通人的工作与生活，体现幸福是奋斗出来的思想。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 星期日档案粤 及 防灾贴士你要知2粤
programme.desc: 高学历、高收入、高职位的女士，不止难找另一半，要与生理时钟竞赛，孕育下一代就更难。不少女性选择雪卵，留待日后受孕生育，甚至有单身女士选择到外地借精生子。随著去年12月1日，本港女士以非医学原因，只可以雪卵十年的限制正式取消，女士是否更有生育自主权？本港企业又会否仿傚大型美资企业，将辅助生育疗程纳入员工福利呢？

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 香港欧化飞鹰活络油呈献:中年好声音4粤
programme.desc: 七十强PK战，来到最终回。蔡宓婕的<给我一个理由忘记，让海儿「起鸡皮」！林靖枝拣选偶像之歌<灵魂相认，透露曾获「轩公」亲自嘉许。上轮夺五灯的科亚高巴再以英文歌出战，能否延续佳绩？另一五灯选手雷小雷柔声诉说<女人花，周国丰形容像在听诗篇。某位藉较少灯数入围的参赛者令评审们眼前一亮，成功晋级。蒙面艺人方面，唐伯虎、鹿七伯、树熊公子、企鹅人都在这集登场，如未能跻身最后四十强，就要摘下面具离开舞台。

programme.title: 一周星星粤PG
programme.desc: 黄子华曾担任郑秀文演唱会嘉宾，当时直言不熟对方，秀文为报恩参演其贺岁片，两人开始变熟，还联同戏中演员王丹妮、廖子妤齐齐受访。片中子华有露上身镜头，他自言有演员道德，未有操练时更是「小林雪」？秀文亦忆述体重的上上落落，奉劝观众不要「模仿」！问到当年买名车一事，子华似不想答，但面对身旁几双好奇眼睛，只好将「黑历史」公开。丹妮、子妤协力向前辈「本尊Fact Check」，过程可谓一额汗，还担心有人会嬲？

programme.title: 马到功成万象新 2026蓉港新春晚会粤
programme.desc: 香港、成都艺人跨地域汇演，祝愿新一年马到功成，万象更新！黎耀祥、陈豪、陈展鹏、林夏薇、萧正楠、吴若希、胡鸿钧等，以MV形式唤起港剧金曲情怀。谢雪心、谢晓莹演绎粤剧<求神；「声梦」歌手联乘儿童合唱团，颂赞<东方之珠。唐文龙与莫宛萤、高久尚等健儿施展咏春、太极、刀术武艺，奉上「精武」盛宴。蓉港两地艺人分别献声贺新禧；冼靖峰、岳圣杰结伴潮游双城食玩潮点。三队内地人气女团汇聚成都，舞动节庆欢乐。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 少年中医说粤普
programme.desc: 节目聚焦于青年族群体验中医药文化，集结中国七所中医药的7名高校学子，在主持人和中医药名家的带领下，探寻中华医圣故里，以「盲盒路线分组体验」医圣故里的形式，了解医圣对当代中医药发展的启示。

programme.title: 甜心先生粤
programme.desc: 周奕玮经常走访不同国家，因此有机会见识不同甜品。最近，他趁著到日本旅游机会，品尝了一款充满地道风味的抹茶Tiramisu，并希望亲手试做，再三回味，甜品达人古嘉俊(阿古)因应他的口味，示范「抹茶蓝莓蛋糕」。蛋糕外表色彩缤纷，紫红色蓝莓镜面配上花花装饰后，增添和风。至于口味方面，抹茶蛋糕配以蓝莓白朱古力慕丝，以创新组合为食家送上新鲜感。向甜品达人偷师当然获益良多，周奕玮还寻获无比乐趣。

programme.title: 魔都女行粤
programme.desc: 糖妹、谷娅溦置身「魔都」上海，来到地标武康大楼跟前，用小嘴巴浅嚼大楼面包另类打卡后，启动「早咖晚酒」生活。大吃手撕猪肉贝果，专家糖妹试后感如何？寻觅隐世小店，必点镇店菜肉馄饨。医肚后逛逛街，主打迷你装束的时尚女装店，血拼解锁！走进玻璃屋餐厅，生牛肉塔塔、开心果碎甜虾等满桌美食卖相精致，糖妹品尝布拉塔芝士，味道「古怪」却吃不停口？入夜，怎可错过上海本邦菜，黑松露红烧肉、松鼠桂鱼，打卡指数又有多高？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 肥妈和6号前往位于元朗的有机农场，搜罗多种「有营」蔬果，为主打健康的新一辑节目打响头炮。番茄含有丰富茄红素，多吃有助保护心脏、预防前列腺疾病。二人试食黑皮车厘茄，竟渗出阵阵烟肉风味！制作「羽衣甘蓝番茄藜麦干果沙律」，务要将蔬菜切碎，当中有何饮食智慧？「南瓜粟米腰果汤」滋补脾胃；另一道「南瓜汤浸比目鱼」做法简单，奥米加3却有护眼强脑功效。「煎焗无激素鸡」选用丹麦自然放养鸡，嫩滑鸡胸更令肥妈情有独钟。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 肥妈今回选用鸭的多个部位煮出四道美馔，果然「点煮都Duck」！「白卤水鸭」香浓味美，与有色卤水汁有何不同？啤梨搭配鸭肝同吃，可中和油腻感。一道「煎鸭肝烩啤梨」讲求火候掌控，6号却以慢活节奏为啤梨切片，阿妈不禁火起！6号再探有机农场，初尝翠玉瓜人工授粉步骤，还替肥妈摘取新鲜的荷兰豆和甜豆。肥妈以含有高蛋白质、铁质的鸭胸，配合「孖豆」爆炒菜式；再带来「翠玉彩椒炒鸭肾」，处理鸭肾、鸭心又有甚么需要注意？

programme.title: 熊猫一家人粤普
programme.desc: 两组实习生的导师李德红和李蓉分别因为休假和参加培训而迎来了代班导师牟长雨和胡荣强，实习生们和两位导师会产生什么样的化学作用呢？另外为了庆祝将满一岁的鑫鑫的宝宝，马余英和金奕霖准备给牠做一个食物丰容…

programme.title: 绅士与小姐
programme.desc: 【韩国收视破38%韩版《真善美》重拾幸福时光】《我唯一的守护者》编剧金始庆最新家庭剧新作，与爸爸、继母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因继兄继母闯祸被诈骗，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面对爸爸的偏坦对待，朴丹丹愤而离家，因缘际会下来到有钱人家担任住宿教师，陪伴失去母亲的三个孩子，而他们的爸爸便是高冷霸道总裁李英国，在妻子早逝后，英国的内心渐渐封闭，与孩子间也产生隔阂，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出现，加上孩子们的凑合，幸福将再次降临。

programme.title: 好搭档
programme.desc: 【张娜拉火力全开！杠上小三、手撕出轨老公超过瘾】王牌律师遇上菜鸟新人，一场法庭与情感的双重对决即将展开！《好搭档》讲述拥有17年经验的离婚律师车恩京，在面对丈夫背叛后，与热血正义的新人韩宥利成为「最不可能搭档」的办公室火花组合。冷面魔头与理想主义者，两人从互看不顺眼，到联手应对一桩桩离婚官司，解开婚姻背后的人性两难。冷静与热血交织，掀起一场场心碎又痛快的离婚风暴！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韩版《罗马假期》霸总宋慧乔恋上暖男朴宝剑】出身政客家庭的车秀贤，为了家族牺牲爱情、步入无爱的婚姻，离婚后的人生空虚苍白；金振赫是怀抱梦想的平凡青年，用热情拥抱世界。两人在异国邂逅，相知相爱，却因身分悬殊而痛苦分离。多年后重逢，她已是冷静自持的上司，他是刚入职的新进员工。过往的甜蜜与伤痕浮现，情感再度悄然蔓延。她挣扎于曾经的选择，他则努力冲破阶级的枷锁。爱情，能否再次在现实的夹缝中绽放？

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 奇迹的兄弟(完)
programme.desc: 【《高斯电子公司》裴贤圣不当高富帅，与《精神教练诸葛吉》郑宇奇迹相遇】负债累累的热血青年陆东柱，在以为是人生中最糟糕的一天遇上了特殊神力却来历不明名为「奇迹」的少年。能够深刻感受别人痛苦与绝望，也能治愈别人。为找回他的过去与记忆，两人成为了彼此生命中的一个奇迹相遇。

programme.title: 向风而行
programme.desc: 【《请叫我总监》谭松韵与《清平乐》王凯，飞向天际携手筑梦！！】鹭洲航空客运飞行部副部长顾南亭因公司改制，与性格飒爽不羁的程霄成为上下属和师徒关系。面对接踵而来的突发航空事件，追求稳定秩序的顾南亭时常被不按常理出牌的程霄打乱计划，共同经历冲击与考验，一路披荆斩棘、相扶成长。

programme.title: 时光之城
programme.desc: 【横跨两国人气演员的偶像剧，张哲瀚携手朴敏英初尝试爱情罗曼史！！】乐观积极的元气少女许真，在前往盖亚影视应征时撞见了当红炸子鸡顾持钧被前女友拒绝的场面。不希望丢脸的事情曝光的顾持钧则从中作梗想赶走许真，却阴错阳差的在盖亚集团二公子林晋修的帮助下，反而成为了顾持钧的助理。朝夕相处、情愫蔓延，却同时卷入了集团的阴谋，两人要如何逃出危机，让有情人终成眷属呢?

programme.title: 爱情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永携手《社内相亲》薛仁雅寻找幸福小确幸！！！】清雅是一名放弃恋爱和结婚，努力在生活中，连续八年准备警察公务员却无法合格的社会小螺丝。俊辉则是一名对他人毫无兴趣的不婚主义者，不管是爱情、友情还是亲情都秉持N分之一的态度。认识了彼此开始寻找琐碎但现实的小确幸，并开始认知爱情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 好搭档
programme.desc: 【张娜拉火力全开！杠上小三、手撕出轨老公超过瘾】王牌律师遇上菜鸟新人，一场法庭与情感的双重对决即将展开！《好搭档》讲述拥有17年经验的离婚律师车恩京，在面对丈夫背叛后，与热血正义的新人韩宥利成为「最不可能搭档」的办公室火花组合。冷面魔头与理想主义者，两人从互看不顺眼，到联手应对一桩桩离婚官司，解开婚姻背后的人性两难。冷静与热血交织，掀起一场场心碎又痛快的离婚风暴！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韩版《罗马假期》霸总宋慧乔恋上暖男朴宝剑】出身政客家庭的车秀贤，为了家族牺牲爱情、步入无爱的婚姻，离婚后的人生空虚苍白；金振赫是怀抱梦想的平凡青年，用热情拥抱世界。两人在异国邂逅，相知相爱，却因身分悬殊而痛苦分离。多年后重逢，她已是冷静自持的上司，他是刚入职的新进员工。过往的甜蜜与伤痕浮现，情感再度悄然蔓延。她挣扎于曾经的选择，他则努力冲破阶级的枷锁。爱情，能否再次在现实的夹缝中绽放？

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.desc: 【横跨两国人气演员的偶像剧，张哲瀚携手朴敏英初尝试爱情罗曼史！！】乐观积极的元气少女许真，在前往盖亚影视应征时撞见了当红炸子鸡顾持钧被前女友拒绝的场面。不希望丢脸的事情曝光的顾持钧则从中作梗想赶走许真，却阴错阳差的在盖亚集团二公子林晋修的帮助下，反而成为了顾持钧的助理。朝夕相处、情愫蔓延，却同时卷入了集团的阴谋，两人要如何逃出危机，让有情人终成眷属呢?

programme.title: 爱情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永携手《社内相亲》薛仁雅寻找幸福小确幸！！！】清雅是一名放弃恋爱和结婚，努力在生活中，连续八年准备警察公务员却无法合格的社会小螺丝。俊辉则是一名对他人毫无兴趣的不婚主义者，不管是爱情、友情还是亲情都秉持N分之一的态度。认识了彼此开始寻找琐碎但现实的小确幸，并开始认知爱情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: Coffy
programme.desc: As a nurse, Coffy (Pam Grier) has seen the ill effects of drugs up close, but it isn't until her little sister becomes addicted to heroin that she finally decides to wage a one-woman battle. Disguised as a prostitute, Coffy goes on a killing rampage, at first going after street dealers and pimps such as sleazy King George (Robert DoQui), then gradually working her way up to bigger honchos. She's shocked, however, when she discovers that her politician boyfriend (Booker Bradshaw) is involved.

Disguised as a prostitute, Coffy goes on a killing rampage, at first going after street dealers and pimps such as sleazy King George (Robert DoQui), then gradually working her way up to bigger honchos. She's shocked, however, when she discovers that her politician boyfriend (Booker Bradshaw) is involved.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: Hondo is told to help make peace with Indian Chief Vittoro, whose daughter--Hondo's wife--had been killed by the Cavalry. Once the peace pipe is smoked, Hondo must deal with a renegade Native American who threatens the peace by randomly attacking settlers.

programme.title: The Holcroft Covenant
programme.desc: The son of a German general becomes part of a mysterious conspiracy to find hidden Nazi funds.

programme.title: Sartana's Here… Trade Your Pistol For A Coffin
programme.desc: Sartana is hired to prevent shipments of gold being continually stolen, but some unscrupulous villains are not happy with this arrangement. Stars George Hilton and Charles Southwood.

programme.title: The Longest Drive
programme.desc: To save an old friend's ranch, the Beaudine brothers round up a gang of misfits to drive a huge herd to market. Join the epic action when a stableman, a retired gunslinger, a dried-out drunk and two sneaky rustlers, hit the dusty trail.

programme.title: Harlequin
programme.desc: An ambitious Australian senator's son is cured of leukaemia by a faith healer, but he discovers that there is a high price to pay. The senator is overjoyed when his son is pronounced well, but then he learns that the mysterious healer has seduced his wife and is threatening to disrupt his political career.

programme.title: From Hell To Victory
programme.desc: On August 24, 1939, at a small French cafe, six friends are about to go their separate ways. They vow to reunite on that day each year at the cafe. The film follows each of their lives: one begins work with the French resistance, one joins the French commandos, another is forced to join the Nazi army, one becomes a flier, and the two others are just simple officers. On the day Paris is liberated, the three surviving friends meet at the cafe and get drunk.

programme.title: Baby Einstein - Baby Monet: Discovering the Seasons
programme.desc: As babies grow and change, so does the landscape around them. From fiery red leaves to falling snowflakes; from flowers in bloom to fireworks in July, every season of the year has its own magic just waiting to be discovered. BABY MONET takes little ones on a sight-and-sound-filled journey through spring, summer, fall and winter using puppet shows, images of nature, children, toys, and masterpieces by Claude Monet set to excerpts from composer Antonio Vivaldi's timeless "The Four Seasons."

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Justice - EP115
programme.desc: In this episode, we will discover that justice is when we are all treated equally, regardless of our differences, and we must give and receive the same attention to other people. Respect is shown by good treatment, complying with the laws to live in peace! We will also understand freedom and how to use it intelligently.

programme.title: Casper the Friendly Ghost - Casper the Friendly Ghost Ep20 - EP120
programme.desc: Depressed by the antics of the other ghosts, Casper leaves home to make friends. After unintentionally scaring several potential pals, Casper befriends two young children. They take him home, where Casper frightens their mother. Casper is again upset because he believes that he will always scare away his potential buddies. However, Casper scares away a banker who is coming to foreclose on the woman's house, and this wins her heart for Casper.

programme.title: Baby Einstein - Baby Newton: All About Shapes
programme.desc: With the Dolittle, and other Baby programs under their belts, the tots who follow Julie Aigner-Clark's Baby Einstein series will sidle up to Baby Newton expecting a similar exploration of building blocks to brilliance, but this time there's a wrinkle or two. Animation makes its first appearance, and parents steeped in keep-it-simple culture may object to the springy "I Know My Shapes" song, a departure from classical-only video predecessors.

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Communication - EP116
programme.desc: In this episode, we will discover the value and importance of communication. We will learn the correct ways to communicate and the main rules of the good listener. We will know in which sites we can raise our voice and when we should respect the silence of others. We will talk about rumours and how harmful they are for effective communication.

programme.desc: Miranda makes a cure to cheer up Mia, but she runs out of Happy Bird Eggs!

programme.title: Monster Town - Monster Town - A Contest
programme.desc: Max and Mike argue about who is the strongest monster

programme.title: Monster Town - Monster Town - The Magnetic Rock
programme.desc: Miranda takes a drive through the forest and hears a humming noise coming from a rock on the side of the mountain, which suddenly pulls her towards it

programme.title: Monster Town - Monster Town - Chasing Mia
programme.desc: Mia is blown away in a strong wind while trying to retrieve Miranda's kite, and the Monster Trucks are in pursuit!

programme.title: Argo's World
programme.desc: Join Marie and Argo in this exciting STEM edutainment mixed-media series as they venture through Cyberspace and make discoveries about the world through historical figures and notable real-world personalities! Special guests include a founding father of the Internet, a NASA astronaut, a top robotics expert, and clever folks from M.I.T!

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | Terror Tubes Takedown | Episode 7
programme.desc: The Gang dives headfirst into the Fear Zone - and it’s pure chaos. With Nightmare Mode activated and the Fear Bomb ticking, only faith can light the way.

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | The Breath of Courage | Episode 8
programme.desc: With 60 seconds left, the Fear Bomb ticks toward doom. Kungfuda and God's Gang fight with faith and love - will light prevail or fear win?

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | Alien Mayhem! | Episode 1, 2, 3
programme.desc: God’s Gang faces insane challenges - from stopping a mad scientist to battling aliens and saving blue whales.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyson the Tanker refuels Jeremy
programme.desc: Oh no, Jeremy ran out of gas! Troy selects the most perfect truck to refuel him: Tyson the Tanker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Francis the Forklift helps at the construction site
programme.desc: Edgar made a mess at the construction site! Troy selects the best truck to help with the clean-up: Francis the Forklift!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyler the Tyke steals candy
programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Imagination Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels tell Duggee that they have nothing left to play with, he encourages them to use their imagination.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Recipe Badge
programme.desc: The hungry Squirrels turn to Duggee when they aren't sure what to eat. Fortunately, he has his cookbook The Clubhouse Kitchen: Tasty Bites for Hungry Squirrels.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - What's Hot?
programme.desc: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&amp;E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what's hot and what's not.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Central Park, New York
programme.desc: Glitch visits Broadway, while the Go Jetters tackle a huge cloud of smog in Central Park.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Grapefruit
programme.desc: Grapefruit dedicates the song "All My Friends" to the pals who go with her everywhere.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S2) - Leek
programme.desc: Leek won't let the conditions backstage stop him from singing "Can't Hold Me Down".

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Evil Pea's Party Plan
programme.desc: It's Evil Pea's birthday, but she and Carrot are trapped in the bottom of her freezer. They must put their differences aside and work together to escape.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Sweetieland Saga
programme.desc: Evil Pea cheats Chilli out of winning floofy teddies at a funfair made from sweets, so Supertato and the Veggies must get the teddies back before it's too late!

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Bottom Bump
programme.desc: The Teletubbies bottom bounce on The Tubby Bouncy before wiggling their bottoms to a special bottom bump song.

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his father's death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the "Toad Stance" and accidentally unveils his true identity...

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Kung Fu legend Ti Lung stars in the action movie as Fu Xue Hong, embarking on a epic journey of revenge for his father.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from "Nine Yang Scriptures" by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal...

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic "The Water Margin", and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Tou Kuan is a wealthy Kwangtung brat with a good kung fu background, he has only one ambition: to pit his wits against three shady masters of the North. The first, conman Che Tsai. The second, a professional romantic dubbed The Terrific. Terrific introduces Tou Kuan to his third rival, Thief Shih San-shou.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: The film is about a Chinese martial arts school finds itself outclassed by their rivals, they hire elite ninja from Japan to destroy the school. The lone survivor of the massacre learns the secrets of ninjutsu and seeks revenge against the ninja.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: One of Shaw Studio's highest grossing movies ever, this is the story of Li Chin Huan, the renowned, charming and sentimental swordsman who must fight many opponents, including an evil Clan Chief, for a place in the martial arts world.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon "Thundering Sword" to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quickly fall for each other, but when Chiao accidentally injures Zheng, things become complicated.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien; Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop (Sun Chien) who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness &amp;amp; innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Warrior Tuan Chang Qing meets courtesan Liu Yin Xi in a small town. Liu pleads Tuan to kill the underworld master Guo Tian Sheng, known as the "Killer Doctor", in order to avenge the death of her fiance. Tuan and gambling addict Xiao Dao breaks into Guo's household, triggering the battle of good against evil.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, &amp;amp; colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general's escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way.

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general's escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: Kuei Chih-hung was famous for his modern day crime thrillers, his horror flicks, and even his comedies. But if the only kung-fu film he ever made was this one, he'd still be spoken of with respect by even the most ardent martial arts movie fan. Many consider this real life martial arts champion Chen Kuan-tai's best performance. As a deeply, even obsessively, dedicated Chief Court Constable, he illuminates the screen with fighting skill and emotional passion.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gang's leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the end?

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friend's grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.
